name: propylhexedrine
purpose: Uses Temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to a cold, hay fever, or other upper respiratory allergies (allergic rhinitis).
uses: Uses For the temporarily relief of nasal congestion due to a cold, hay fever, or other upper respiratory allergies (allergic rhinitis).
otcwarn: Do not use this product for more than three days. Stop use and consult a doctor if symptoms persist.
